title: Giraffe eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Ground -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="92" rx="40" ry="5" fill="#4a7c3f"/>

  <!-- Giraffe body -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="68" rx="20" ry="14" fill="#f4b942"/>

  <!-- Body spots -->
  <circle cx="30" cy="62" r="3" fill="#c47a1a"/>
  <circle cx="40" cy="58" r="3.5" fill="#c47a1a"/>
  <circle cx="47" cy="65" r="3" fill="#c47a1a"/>
  <circle cx="35" cy="72" r="2.5" fill="#c47a1a"/>
  <circle cx="45" cy="74" r="2.5" fill="#c47a1a"/>
  <circle cx="26" cy="70" r="2.5" fill="#c47a1a"/>

  <!-- Legs -->
  <rect x="26" y="78" width="4" height="12" rx="2" fill="#e8a82e"/>
  <rect x="34" y="78" width="4" height="12" rx="2" fill="#e8a82e"/>
  <rect x="42" y="78" width="4" height="12" rx="2" fill="#e8a82e"/>
  <rect x="49" y="78" width="4" height="12" rx="2" fill="#e8a82e"/>

  <!-- Neck -->
  <path d="M 50 60 Q 56 40 62 26 L 70 28 Q 64 44 56 64 Z" fill="#f4b942"/>

  <!-- Neck spots -->
  <circle cx="56" cy="50" r="2.5" fill="#c47a1a"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="42" r="2.5" fill="#c47a1a"/>
  <circle cx="63" cy="34" r="2.5" fill="#c47a1a"/>

  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx="66" cy="22" rx="9" ry="7" fill="#f4b942"/>

  <!-- Ossicones (horns) -->
  <line x1="62" y1="16" x2="60" y2="10" stroke="#e8a82e" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="9" r="2" fill="#c47a1a"/>
  <line x1="70" y1="16" x2="72" y2="10" stroke="#e8a82e" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="9" r="2" fill="#c47a1a"/>

  <!-- Ear -->
  <ellipse cx="58" cy="18" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#e8a82e" transform="rotate(-20 58 18)"/>

  <!-- Eye -->
  <circle cx="69" cy="21" r="1.8" fill="#3a2210"/>
  <circle cx="69.6" cy="20.4" r="0.6" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <!-- Snout/muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx="74" cy="25" rx="4" ry="3.5" fill="#e8a82e"/>

  <!-- Nostril -->
  <circle cx="76" cy="24.5" r="0.6" fill="#a05a10"/>

  <!-- Mouth eating -->
  <path d="M 74 27 Q 76 29 78 27" fill="none" stroke="#a05a10" stroke-width="0.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Leaf being eaten -->
  <path d="M 77 28 Q 82 26 84 30 Q 82 32 77 30 Z" fill="#5cc44a"/>
  <path d="M 77 29 Q 81 29 83 30" fill="none" stroke="#3a9a2a" stroke-width="0.6"/>
  <line x1="77" y1="29" x2="76" y2="30" stroke="#3a9a2a" stroke-width="0.8"/>

  <!-- Another leaf -->
  <path d="M 80 25 Q 86 22 88 26 Q 85 28 80 26 Z" fill="#6ed45c"/>

  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d="M 19 65 Q 14 68 13 72" fill="none" stroke="#e8a82e" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="13" cy="73" r="2" fill="#c47a1a"/>

  <!-- Smile detail -->
  <circle cx="64" cy="26" r="0.8" fill="#d49030"/>
</svg>
